lines.japanese: それから鳴を迎えに行って、俺たちはふたりピンフ通りの雑踏に紛れながらヘテロクロミアへ辿りついた。
lines.english: Then I went back for Naru, and the two of us reached Heterochromia by losing ourselves in the crowds of Pinfu Street.

lines.japanese: 物珍しげに首を巡らせているやつを引いて、あの急な階段を下る。
lines.english: I guided Naru down the steep staircase while she looked around in fascination.

lines.japanese: モテ髭の黒服は、鳴の姿を見ても「制服入場は原則禁止だけど、ソレって制服のコスプレでしょ？」と心の広いことを言ってあっけなく扉を開いた。
lines.english: Even when he saw Naru, Lady-Killer Goatee in black generously went, ‘School uniforms are against the rules, but that's uniform cosplay, right?’ and opened the door without a fuss.

lines.japanese: どうしようもない店だ。
lines.english: This place was beyond saving.

lines.japanese: この箱における土曜の夜は、まだ始まったばかりみたいだった。
lines.english: Saturday night at the club seemed to have only just begun.

lines.japanese: チョイ悪フレーバーな中年ＤＪは、聴き覚えないのになんとなく懐かしい匂いのするファンキーなディスコクラシックを回していた。
lines.english: The middle-aged DJ putting on a fashionable bad-boy act was spinning funky disco classics I'd never heard but that somehow smelled nostalgic.

lines.japanese: 遠慮のない色あざやかな照明が、ミラーボールの鱗に反射して柔らかな光の雨を降りまく。今日のパーティーはそういうコンセプトなんだろうか。闇の中を鋭いレーザーが貫いてゆくような、いつもの雰囲気とは違う。
lines.english: Brazenly vivid lights struck the scales of the mirror ball and sent down a ceaseless, gentle rain of light. Maybe that was tonight's theme. It felt different from the usual atmosphere, with its sharp lasers lancing through darkness.

lines.japanese: まだ隙間の多いフロアでは、揃いのタンクトップにバギーパンツの一団が、混雑しだした後ではなかなか披露できない華麗なダンスセッションを繰りひろげていた。
lines.english: On the still-spacious floor, a crew in matching tank tops and baggy pants was busting out a fancy dance session they could never manage once the place got crowded.

lines.japanese: 「ほあー……」
lines.english: “Whoa...”

lines.japanese: 鳴はいつになく口を開け、天井の可動式ライトにも負けないぐらい忙しく首を振って、上下左右・縦横斜めを隅から隅まで眺めたおしていた。
lines.english: Naru stared openmouthed, her head turning nearly as fast as the moving lights overhead while she took in every corner—up, down, left, right, and diagonally across.

lines.japanese: とくに、ひとつのスツールに向かい合わせで座って互いの唇をついばんでいた若いゲイカップルには、たいそうカルチャーショックを受けているようだった。
lines.english: A young gay couple perched face-to-face on a single stool, nibbling at each other's lips, seemed to give her a particularly severe culture shock.

lines.japanese: 「あわ、あわわわ……こんな空気、あと五分も吸っていたら不良になってしまう……」
lines.english: Awa, awawawa... Another five minutes breathing this air and I'm gonna turn into a delinquent...

lines.japanese: 「ヨーロッパ育ちがなに青いこと言ってんだ。いいからこっち」
lines.english: “You grew up in Europe. What are you acting so sheltered for? Come on, this way.”

lines.japanese: 足を動かすことさえ忘れがちな鳴を引っぱって、俺は箱の中を壁づたいに進んだ。
lines.english: I dragged Naru, who kept forgetting even to move her feet, along the wall through the club.

lines.japanese: しかしガラスの温室の特等席に、あのふんぞりかえった殿様の姿はなかった。時間が早かったのだろうか。不貞腐れた様相のロンゲがひとり、片あぐらをかいているだけだ。
lines.english: But the lord who normally sprawled in the finest seat of the glass conservatory was nowhere to be seen. Maybe it was still too early. Only a single long-haired man sat there with one leg folded, looking thoroughly sullen.

lines.japanese: 「あ、おい森──」
lines.english: “Oh, hey, Mori—”

lines.japanese: 「──シカトかよ」
lines.english: “—you're ignoring me, huh.”

lines.japanese: いま、たしかに視線がぶつかったが、やつの目はそのまま流れに乗ってふいと離れていった。ふん。相変わらず無愛想なやつだ。
lines.english: Our eyes had definitely met, but his gaze simply caught the current and drifted away. Hmph. As unfriendly as ever.

lines.japanese: 途方に暮れて後ろ頭を掻いていると、鳴が爪先立って俺の耳に声を投げつけた。
lines.english: As I scratched the back of my head at a loss, Naru rose onto her toes and shouted into my ear.

lines.japanese: 「どうしたんですかー」
lines.english: “What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 俺は腰を折ってやつの耳に投げかえす。
lines.english: I bent and shouted back into her ear.

lines.japanese: 「いや、おまえの兄貴いると思ったんだけどー」
lines.english: “I thought your brother would be here.”

lines.japanese: 兄貴という単語を出したとたん、やつは飛びのくように俺から距離を置いて、きょろきょろと落ちつきなく左右を窺った。
lines.english: The instant I said ‘brother,’ she sprang away from me and nervously searched from side to side.

lines.japanese: 唇がふにゃふにゃ動いているが、２０年ぐらい前の「ゴキゲンなナンバー」に邪魔されて声が届いてこない。しかし表情と手の動きだけ見るに──ああ、照れてるのか。
lines.english: Her lips were moving, but a twenty-year-old “groovy number” drowned her out. From her face and fluttering hands, though—oh. She was embarrassed.

lines.japanese: 「なに。兄貴と喧嘩でもしてんの」
lines.english: “What? Are you fighting with your brother or something?”

lines.japanese: 俺はふたたび顔を近づけて言った。
lines.english: I leaned close again to speak.

lines.japanese: 「そっ、そおゆうわけじゃないんですけどおー」
lines.english: “N-no, it isn't like that.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、いいじゃん。おまえ、今日は兄貴に送ってもらえよ」
lines.english: “Then what's the problem? Have him take you home tonight.”

lines.japanese: 「た、頼めませんよう、そんなこと！」
lines.english: “I-I can't ask him to do that!”

lines.japanese: 「なに。なんで。あいつ、なんだかんだ言って最後には妹に甘ぇぞ」
lines.english: “What? Why? Whatever he says, he always gives in to his little sister in the end.”

lines.japanese: 「知りませんよう。だから、最近まともに話してないんですってー」
lines.english: “I wouldn't know. That's why I told you, we hardly even speak anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、じゃあいい機会じゃん。今日まともに話せよ」
lines.english: “Then today's the perfect opportunity. Have a real conversation with him.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、そんなこといきなり言われても、何を話せばいいんだかー」
lines.english: “But if you spring that on me, I don't even know what to say.”

lines.japanese: ついに体ごとふにゃふにゃしだした。
lines.english: Now her whole body had gone soft and floppy.

lines.japanese: 「あー、左右田さんたちだー」
lines.english: “Oh, there's Souda and the others.”

lines.japanese: 「おい。おい女。おまえ、話逸らすんじゃねえよ。こんなとこに、そんな都合よく知り合いが通るわけ──」
lines.english: “Hey. Hey, woman. Don't change the subject. What are the odds somebody you know would just happen to pass by in a place like—”

lines.japanese: 「よーお、成田君！」
lines.english: “Heeey, Narita!”

lines.japanese: 「──通んのかよ」
lines.english: “—so they would.”

lines.japanese: まあ、そうか。ここはフレイムバーズの溜まり場だった。
lines.english: Well, of course. This was a Flame Birds haunt.

lines.japanese: いいかげん見覚えのあるハゲやドレッドやウルフヘアたちが、バーカンの方からぞろぞろと湧きでてくる。クリアカップを持っていない方の手でチームのハンドサインを作り、それを胸の前で二度三度ぶんぶん振った。
lines.english: The now-familiar assortment of bald heads, dreadlocks, and shag cuts came streaming from the bar. With whichever hand wasn’t holding a clear cup, they formed their crew’s sign and swung it two or three times before their chests.

lines.japanese: 「ヤーマン！　鳴タロいらっしゃ～い、成田チャンも一服いっとく～？」
lines.english: “Yah, man! Welcome, Naru-taro! You want a puff too, Nari-baby?”

lines.japanese: やつらは馬鹿でかい口を開けて、賑わしいディスコチューンにも負けない脳天気な声を張りあげる。
lines.english: They opened their huge mouths and yelled cheerfully enough to beat out the loud disco tune.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと鳴さーん！　いいのォ、こんなガラの悪いとこ来ちゃってェ！　翔さんに怒られちゃンじゃねえ？」
lines.english: Heyyy, Naru! You suuuure you should be coming to a rough place like thiiis? Won't Kakeru be maaad?

lines.japanese: 「違うんですう、なんかこのひとに連れてこられたんですう！」
lines.english: “It isn't my fault! This man dragged me here!”

lines.japanese: 「しかも鳴タロ制服じゃ～ん！　ガッコのセンセに通報されたって、オッチャン知らないからねェ～！」
lines.english: And Naru-taro's even in unifooorm! If somebody rats you out to a teacher, don't come crying to Unc, okaaaay?

lines.japanese: 「違うんですう、なんかこのひとがマニアなんですう！」
lines.english: Nooo, it's not like that! This guy has a uniform feeetish!

lines.japanese: 俺はいつもの漫談には加わらず、むさ苦しい男どもに冷静な声を放った。
lines.english: I didn't join their usual comedy routine. I spoke calmly to the bunch of sweaty men.

lines.japanese: 「あんさ、おまえら今日、彼女とか一緒じゃないの」
lines.english: Hey, none of you guys brought your girlfriends tonight?

lines.japanese: 「う、ううう、うるせえな！　そそ、そんなんオマエ……い、いるに決まってんだろ！」
lines.english: “Wh-wh-wh-what's that supposed to mean? O-of course we have girlfriends!”

lines.japanese: 「そそそ、そうだよ、今日はたまたま連れてこなかっただけだよ！」
lines.english: “Y-yeah, exactly! We just happened not to bring them tonight!”

lines.japanese: 「くっそう、たまに女連れだからって見下しやがって、このにわか野郎……」
lines.english: “Goddamn poser. Thinks he can look down on us because he occasionally shows up with a woman...”

lines.japanese: やつらは勘違いして勝手にいきり立った。
lines.english: They misunderstood and worked themselves into a fury all by themselves.

lines.japanese: 「違げえよ、恋人の有無なんか聞いてねえよ。じゃなくて、ほらこいつ、こんなんだから──」
lines.english: “That's not what I meant. I didn't ask whether you have girlfriends. I mean, look at what she's wearing—”

lines.japanese: 俺は親指で鳴の着ているものを示した。
lines.english: I indicated Naru's clothes with my thumb.

lines.japanese: 「──女もんの着替えとか持ってきてるやついたら、借りらんねえかと思って」
lines.english: “—so I thought if somebody had brought a change of women's clothes, maybe we could borrow them.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、なーんだ、そういうことすか！」
lines.english: “Oh! That's what you meant!”

lines.japanese: 「やだなあ成田チャン、はやく言ってよぉ～！　そういうことなら大丈夫よぉ」
lines.english: Oh, Nari-baby, come ooon, you should've said so sooner! If that's it, you're fiiine.

lines.japanese: 「ライツ。その通りこの店にゃあ、スーツで遊びに来たＯＬのねーちゃんがたっぷり男を誘えるように、軽くてクールで腰の振りやすい服がばっちり用意してあるぜ」
lines.english: Ri-iight! That's right, this place has all the light, cool, easy-to-shake-your-hips-in gear an office chick in a suit needs to pick up as many guys as she wants!

lines.japanese: 体のでかい小僧たちが、でかい声で自慢気に言う。俺は鳴の耳元で声を張った。
lines.english: The enormous boys boasted in enormous voices. I raised mine beside Naru's ear.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあおまえ、補導されねえようにとりあえず着替えとけ」
lines.english: “Then change for now so the cops don't pick you up.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、いくら似合うからって、私ボディコンとかラメラメはやーですよー？」
lines.english: Aww, just because it'd look good on me doesn't mean I'm wearing some skintight dress or getting covered in glitter, okaaaay?

lines.japanese: 「おっけ！　まーかシて！　いまどきそんなダッセーんじゃねえから！　ファッション誌にも載っちゃうような、超イカしたデザインよ？」
lines.english: Okaaay! Leave it to meee! We don't do that lame crap anymore! These designs are so freakin' hot they could be in a fashion magazine, got it?

lines.japanese: 「ほっ、まじですか」
lines.english: “Oh! Seriously?”

lines.japanese: 「まー、あんな服で迫られたら、も、どんな男もたちどころにクラッと来ちゃうよな～あ」
lines.english: “Man, walk up to any guy dressed like that and you'll make him dizzy on the spot.”

lines.japanese: 「まじですか！」
lines.english: “Seriously!”

lines.japanese: 「おう、クロークはこっちだ、付いてきな」
lines.english: “Yeah. The lockers are this way. Follow me.”

lines.japanese: ハゲが巨体を揺らしながらロッカーの方へ向かった。鳴が保護者の許可でも求めるような顔で俺を見上げる。俺は舌先で頬を膨らませながら、目と顎で「付いていけ」と命じた。
lines.english: The bald man set off toward the lockers, his enormous body swaying. Naru looked up at me like a child seeking a guardian's permission. I pushed out my cheek with my tongue and ordered her to follow with my eyes and chin.

lines.japanese: とっとこと場違いな後ろ姿が遠ざかる。
lines.english: Her incongruous figure went pattering away.

lines.japanese: 残ったドレッドたちが、俺になにか飲むかと訊いてきた。俺は片手を上げて気ィ遣うなと言った。やつらは「そんじゃ」と言って、少し離れた空席にどっかり腰を下ろした。
lines.english: The dreads who stayed asked if I wanted something to drink. I raised a hand and told them not to worry about me. ‘All right,’ they said, then dropped into some empty seats a little ways off.

lines.japanese: ひとりになった俺は、知らない巨乳ねーちゃんの踊りくるう胸をしばらく眺めていたが、やはり今日ばかりは何の感動も訪れなかった。
lines.english: Left alone, I spent a while watching some busty chick's tits bounce as she danced, but even that did nothing for me tonight.

lines.japanese: 俺は鳴を待たずにＶＩＰルームへ足を入れた。
lines.english: Without waiting for Naru, I entered the VIP room.

lines.japanese: 追放されたはずの家臣は、主君のいない玉座に悠々と身を沈めていた。
lines.english: The vassal who had supposedly been banished lounged at ease upon his absent lord's throne.

lines.japanese: 「おう」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese: やつはガラスを隔てた向こう、大スクリーンの退屈な映像に目を向けていたが、俺が声をかけるとゆっくりこちらへ視線をよこした。
lines.english: He was watching the dull images on the big screen beyond the glass. When I spoke, he slowly turned his eyes toward me.

lines.japanese: 「あんさ。いま俺ぶっちゃけヨユーねえから、いきなし本題入るけど」
lines.english: “Look. I’m pretty damn pressed right now, so I’m cutting to the chase.”

lines.japanese: 森里は鼻息で返答し、ふんぞり返ったまま首をほぐすようにぐるんと回した。いかにも「めんどくせえなあ」という態度だった。
lines.english: Morisato snorted in reply and rolled his neck as if loosening it, still sprawled in the seat. Every inch of him said, *What a pain.*

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、きのう亜衣をどこまで送ってったの」
lines.english: “How far did you take Ai last night?”

lines.japanese: それはあいつの現状──悲惨な現状──を知っているのかという問いでもあった。
lines.english: I was also asking whether he knew about her situation—her miserable situation.

lines.japanese: 「あァ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「あァじゃねえよ。おまえ、きのう亜衣と一緒に帰っただろ。どこで別れたんだよ」
lines.english: “Don't ‘huh’ me. You went home with Ai last night. Where did you leave her?”

lines.japanese: 「どこってべつに……フツーに駅までだよ」
lines.english: “Where? Nowhere special... I took her to the station.”

lines.japanese: 「なに。あの時間でまだ電車あったの」
lines.english: “There were still trains that late?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ないから朝までカラオケで時間潰して。あァ、なんでよ？」
lines.english: “No. We killed time at karaoke until morning. Why?”

lines.japanese: やつは長い髪に前から指を通して、億劫そうに聞きかえしてきた。俺はさらに尋ねた。
lines.english: He ran his fingers back through his long hair and wearily asked me to repeat myself. I asked again.

lines.japanese: 「家まで送ってねえの」
lines.english: “You didn't take her home?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……まあ、あいつが嫌がったから」
lines.english: “No... Well, she didn't want me to.”

lines.japanese: 「なにを嫌がったの」
lines.english: “Didn't want what?”

lines.japanese: 「だから……あんまりひとに泣き顔見せたくねーんだと」
lines.english: “She said... she didn't want anyone to see her crying.”

lines.japanese: 「なに。なに泣かせてんだよ、おまえ」
lines.english: “What? Why'd you make her cry?”

lines.japanese: 「うーっわ、うぜ！　こいつ、マジうぜえわ。あああ、うぜうぜうぜっ！」
lines.english: “Oh my God, you're annoying! This guy is so goddamn annoying. Ahhh, annoying, annoying, annoying!”

lines.japanese: 森里は俯いて長い髪で表情を隠し、狂ったように頭を振った。
lines.english: Morisato bowed his head until his long hair hid his face, then shook it like a madman.

lines.japanese: 俺は負けじと後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。もういい。こんなところで責任の所在を追及してる暇があったら、一秒でも早くあいつを救いだしてやるべきだ。
lines.english: I scratched hard at the back of my head too. Enough. No time to sit here figuring out whose fault it was. Every second should go to getting her out.

lines.japanese: だが、その前にもうひとつ。
lines.english: But first, one more thing.

lines.japanese: 「なあ。いま鳳いねえの」
lines.english: “Hey. Ohtori isn't here?”

lines.japanese: 「見りゃ分かんだろ、いねえよ。いまっつうか、ずっといねえかもな」
lines.english: “You have eyes. He's not here. And I don't know if he'll ever be here again.”

lines.japanese: 森里は頭を下げたまま肩を揺らした。こいつほど拗ねてるのが分かりやすい男もそうはいない。
lines.english: Morisato kept his head down, shoulders shaking. Guy couldn't have made it any more obvious he was sulking.

lines.japanese: 「なに。どういうこと」
lines.english: “What? What's that supposed to mean?”

lines.japanese: 「あのひとは元々、時期が来たら俺たちを捨てるつもりだったんだよ。ハナから後継者も決まってたんだと」
lines.english: “He always planned to throw us away when the time came. Apparently his successor was chosen from the very beginning.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「俺もきのう初めて聞かされたんだけどさ……あーあ、みんなはまだ知らねンだろーなあ」
lines.english: “I only heard it yesterday myself... Haaah. Bet nobody else knows yet.”

lines.japanese: 髪を後ろへ流しながら、やつが頭を上げる。その力ない目がどんよりフロアを一周した。俺も振りかえり、子供みたいなタコ踊りではしゃいでいるレゲエ風やギャル男たちに目を凝らした。
lines.english: Sweeping back his hair, he raised his head. His lifeless eyes made a murky circuit of the floor. I turned too and watched the reggae-styled boys and flashy young men cavorting in childish, octopus-limbed dances.

lines.japanese: “じきに俺にはすべての兵が不要になる”
lines.english: Soon I won't need any soldiers at all.

lines.japanese: たしかに鳳はゆうべ、あの特等席にもたれてそう言っていた──
lines.english: Ohtori had indeed said that the night before as he reclined in his privileged seat—

lines.japanese: ──どういう意味だろう。そろそろ表の仕事に専念する気にでもなったんだろうか。もちろん何も不思議はない。ガチの極道志望でもないかぎり、やつはいいかげん悪ガキごっこを卒業しなけりゃならない歳だ。
lines.english: —what was that supposed to mean? Was he finally planning to focus on his legit work? Nothing weird about that. Unless he seriously wanted to join the mob, he was way too old to still be playing bad boy.

lines.japanese: だからなんだって話。
lines.english: So what?

lines.japanese: 「よく分かんねえけど、どうでもいいや。あのさ、それよりさ」
lines.english: “I don't really get it, but whatever. Look, more importantly...”

lines.japanese: 「あー？」
lines.english: “Yeah?”

lines.japanese: 「あいつ。鳳の妹、置いてくから。兄貴来たら『送ってけ』つっといて」
lines.english: “Her. Ohtori's sister. I'm leaving her here. If her brother comes, tell him to take her home.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だから、来るか分かんねッつってんじゃん」
lines.english: “I just told you, I don't know if he's coming.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、じゃあ来なかったら適当に遊ばせといて。遅くなるかもしんねえけど、俺また、ここ戻ってくるから」
lines.english: “Then let her hang around if he doesn't. I might be late, but I'll come back here.”

lines.japanese: 「なに。おまえ、いまからどっか行くの？」
lines.english: “What? You going somewhere now?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、まあ、ちょっと」
lines.english: “Yeah. Just for a bit.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん、忙しいのね」
lines.english: “Huh. Busy man.”

lines.japanese: 森里は軽薄な調子で言いながら、重厚な視線をよこした。
lines.english: Morisato spoke lightly, but the look he gave me had weight.

lines.japanese: 「なんだったら、みんな連れてけば？」
lines.english: “Why not take everybody with you?”

lines.japanese: みんな、とは戦争ごっこの大好きなデカブツたちだろう。泰平の世の武士団。森里和馬は俺がオウムに狙われていることを知っている。
lines.english: By ‘everybody,’ he meant the giants who loved playing at war. A warrior band born into an age of peace. Kazuma Morisato knew the parrot was after me.

lines.japanese: だが、余計な気遣いだ。俺がフレイムバーズと連れだって「聖地」へ行ったりしたらそれこそ泥沼だ。まとまるものもこじれてしまう。
lines.english: But I didn't need that. If I showed up at their ‘holy ground’ with the Flame Birds in tow, the whole thing would turn into a quagmire. Anything that could've been worked out would just get more tangled.

lines.japanese: 「いや、いらねえ」
lines.english: “No. I don't need them.”

lines.japanese: 「あーそー」
lines.english: “Oh. Right.”

lines.japanese: 森里は気の抜けた返事をしながら、俺の斜め奥へ目を転じた。一瞬遅れて、俺の背に打ち水のような爆音が浴びせかけられる。扉が開かれたんだろう。
lines.english: Morisato gave the listless answer and shifted his gaze past me at an angle. A moment later, an explosive wash of noise splashed across my back. The door must have opened.

lines.japanese: 「おう成田君、待たせたな」
lines.english: “Hey, Narita. Sorry to keep you waiting.”

lines.japanese: 「着替えてきましたー」
lines.english: “I changed!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ。じゃあおまえ、兄貴が来るまでここで──」
lines.english: “Right. Then stay here until your brother—”

lines.japanese: 振りかえった俺は、そこで言葉を失った。
lines.english: I turned around and went speechless.

lines.japanese: よりによって、なんてもん着てるんだこいつ。
lines.english: Of all the damn things, what the hell was she wearing?

lines.japanese: 「ふぇにーっくす」
lines.english: “Phee-nix.”

lines.japanese: 鳴はフレイムバーズのハンドサイン（誰だ、くだらねえもん教えたのは）を横倒しにして、頭のそばでだらだらと上下させた。
lines.english: Naru turned the Flame Birds' hand sign sideways—who taught her that stupid thing?—and flopped it lazily up and down beside her head.

lines.japanese: 「似合いますかー」
lines.english: “Does it suit me?”

lines.japanese: 「Ｈｕｈ、聞くまでもねえぜリルシスタ。見ろよ成田君を、わはは、言葉も出ねーでやんの」
lines.english: “Huh! No need to ask, li'l sister. Look at Narita! Ha ha ha, struck speechless!”

lines.japanese: 「わはは、言葉も出ないか」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha. Struck speechless, is he?”

lines.japanese: たしかに出ない。いまはツッコミなんて入れてる気分じゃない。
lines.english: He was right. I had no words. I wasn't in the mood to make the obvious comeback.

lines.japanese: 「あー」
俺は後ろ頭をゆっくり掻きまぜながら言った。
lines.english: I slowly raked my fingers through the hair at the back of my head before I spoke.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、鳴。おまえ、このおにいさんたちの言うことよく聞いて、あんま世話かけんじゃねーぞ」
lines.english: “All right, Naru. Listen to these guys, and don't make too much trouble for them.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、隼人さんどこか行くんですかー」
lines.english: “What? Are you going somewhere, Hayato?”

lines.japanese: 席を立って歩きだすと、鳴が呑気な声で俺を引きとめた。俺も暗く沈んだ声にならないよう努めて答えた。
lines.english: When I stood and started away, Naru called after me in her carefree voice. I tried to keep my own answer from turning grim.

lines.japanese: 「んー、ちょっとな」
lines.english: “Mm. Just for a while.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Oh.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、なんつうか、これでグダグダなのぜんぶ終わりにするから」
lines.english: Well, like... I'm gonna end all this crap here.
“...What? Huh?”

lines.japanese: ソウルフルな黒人女性のボーカルに呑まれて、俺のあやふやな声は届かなかったんだろう、鳴はわずかに片耳を向けながら曖昧に微笑んだ。
lines.english: The soulful voice of a Black woman singing must have swallowed my uncertain words. Naru cocked her head slightly toward me and gave me a vague smile.

lines.japanese: 「だから、まあ、とにかく──」
lines.english: “So anyway—”

lines.japanese: 俺は狂騒の地下室から流れこんできた煙草くさい空気を深く吸いこんだ。
lines.english: I drew a deep breath of the tobacco-stained air spilling in from the riotous basement.

lines.japanese: 「──明日からまた、ふたりでチャリ探しすんぞ」
lines.english: “—starting tomorrow, you and me are looking for that bike again.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はい！　はい、はい！」
lines.english: “Oh, yes! Yes, yes!”

lines.japanese: 二本指を突きつけると、やつは八重歯を覗かせて何度も首を振った。
lines.english: I thrust two fingers toward her, and she flashed one little fang and nodded over and over.

lines.japanese: 地下室の階段を這いのぼり、駅への道をさかのぼってゆくと、いつしかダンスフロアのバスドラムより熱いアフリカ太鼓の音が聞こえはじめた。
lines.english: I crawled up the basement stairs and retraced the road toward the station. Before long, I began to hear African drums burning hotter than the dance floor's bass drum.

lines.japanese: 俺は戦場へ向かう前に、まずモンキのスポーツ用品コーナーへ立ちよって試合用のバンテージを買った。
lines.english: Before heading to the battlefield, I stopped at the sporting-goods department in Monki and bought competition hand wraps.

lines.japanese: お友達と会うのにわざわざこぶしを痛めないための準備をしておくなんて、俺にしちゃずいぶん物騒な話だ。
lines.english: Getting ready so I wouldn't hurt my fists when I went to see a friend. That's pretty damn violent, even for me.
